competitors.name: General Mills / Totino's
competitors.action: Food Business News reported that General Mills launched Totino's Blasted Pizza Rolls nationwide. The line adds seasoned crusts in garlic Parmesan, spicy nacho and chili-lime profiles, extending a major frozen pizza-snack brand into bolder flavor and texture cues.

competitors.name: Wakefern / Wholesome Pantry
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Wakefern is rolling out refreshed Wholesome Pantry Organic and free-from packaging across frozen, grocery, produce, meat and dairy items. The redesign highlights clean ingredients, everyday value and shelf navigation, while the line remains free from 233 ingredients including artificial preservatives, colors, flavors and sweeteners.

competitors.name: Schnucks Springboard
competitors.action: Progressive Grocer reported Schnucks selected 10 Midwest CPG makers for the third class of its Springboard Emerging Business Accelerator. Participants receive business development support, $5,000 in equity-free funding and, if they clear food safety and certification hurdles, a spring 2027 trial at select Schnucks stores.
